topic: Reporting a Charge You Do Not Recognize

script.title: THE GHOST CHARGES
script.scene_zh: 防詐櫃台 · 申訴扣款
script.story_hook: Two charges appeared that she never made.
script.intro_zh: 帳單上冒出兩筆她根本沒花過的錢。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's fraud desk scene. Listen for dispute phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的防詐櫃台場景。留意申訴扣款的實用說法。
script.outro: And that's a charge dispute filed well. Listen again and try the key asks.
script.outro_zh: 一筆扣款申訴就這樣順利完成。再聽一次，跟著說說關鍵問句。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a Latina grandmother in her fifties with short curly salt-and-pepper hair, red-framed glasses, a rust orange cardigan, a small floral scarf, and a plump build
script.char_b_description: a slim young man in his late twenties with neat dark blond hair, clean-shaven, a light blue oxford shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a lanyard badge, and rectangular glasses

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I have a charge I don't recognize.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi aɪ hæv ə tʃɑɹdʒ aɪ doʊnt ˌrɛkəɡˈnaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我有一筆認不出來的扣款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm Dev, fraud support. Let's look together.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm dɛv fɹɔd səˈpɔɹt lɛts lʊk təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我是防詐組的 Dev。我們一起來看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. This line says NVT Store, forty-nine ninety-nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ðɪs laɪn sɛz ˌɛn vi ˈti stɔɹ ˈfɔɹti naɪn ˈnɪnti naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你。這一行寫的是 NVT Store，四十九塊九毛九。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, have you shopped online anywhere new?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm hæv ju ʃɑpt ˈɑnlaɪn ˈɛnɪˌwɛr nu/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，你最近有沒有在新的網站網購過？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, that's exactly what scared me last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðæts ɪɡˈzæktli wət skɛrd mi læst naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，所以我昨晚看到時才嚇壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understandable. Did you freeze the card already?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstændəbəl dɪd ju froʊz ðə kɑɹd ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 完全理解。你已經先把卡鎖起來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did, the app suggested it right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd ði æp səɡˈdʒɛstɪt ɪt ɹaɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 鎖了，手機軟體當下就建議我這麼做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great instinct. The charge posted Tuesday, see here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ˈɪnˌstɪŋkt ðə tʃɑɹdʒ ˈpoʊstɪd ˈtuzdeɪ si hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 直覺很棒。這筆扣款是星期二入帳的，看這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesday? I didn't even use my card Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzdeɪ aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈivən juz maɪ kɑɹd ˈtuzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 星期二？我那天根本沒用過這張卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, nothing else suspicious after that one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls səˈspɪʃəs ˈæftɚ ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 好，那這筆之後還有別的可疑紀錄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, um, there's a second charge. Thirty-nine ninety-nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ʌm ðɛɹz ə ˈsɛkənd tʃɑɹdʒ ˈθɝti naɪn ˈnɪnti naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 呃，還有第二筆，三十九塊九毛九。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ooh, okay, that one says LTX Digital. Ring a bell?
dialogue.phonetic: /uː oʊˈkeɪ ðæt wʌn sɛz ˌɛl ti ˈɛks ˈdɪdʒɪtəl ɹɪŋ ə bɛl/
dialogue.zh: 噢，好，這一筆寫的是 LTX Digital。有印象嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nope. What could LTX even be?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp wət kʊd ˌɛl ti ˈɛks ˈivən bi/
dialogue.zh: 完全沒有。LTX 到底是什麼啊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Often those codes hide streaming or game stores.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔfən ðoʊz koʊdz haɪd ˈstɹimin ɔɹ ɡeɪm stɔɹz/
dialogue.zh: 這類代碼常常是串流或遊戲商店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait — my grandson knows my card number.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt maɪ ˈɡrænˌsɑn noʊz maɪ kɑɹd ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 等等——我孫子知道我的卡號！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Haha, before we dispute, maybe check with him?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑhɑ bɪˈfɔɹ wi dɪˈsjut ˈmeɪbi tʃɛk wɪð ɪm/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，申訴之前，要不要先問他一聲？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're right, that would be so embarrassing.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ɹaɪt ðæt wʊd bi soʊ ˌɛmbəˈræsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你說得對，可是那樣就太尷尬了耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll wait while you text him. Take your time.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl weɪt waɪl ju tɛkst ɪm teɪk jɔɹ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 你傳訊息問他，我等著。慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay... he says he bought forty-nine ninety-nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ hi sɛz hi bɑt ˈfɔɹti naɪn ˈnɪnti naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好……他說那筆四十九塊九毛九，是他買的遊戲道具。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But there's a second one he didn't buy.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðɛrz ə ˈsɛkənd wʌn hi ˈdɪdənt baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 但第二筆就不是他刷的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right! Thirty-nine ninety-nine is still a mystery.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ˈθɝti naɪn ˈnɪnti naɪn ɪz stɪl ə ˈmɪstɚi/
dialogue.zh: 對啊！三十九塊九毛九還是個謎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we dispute just that second charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi dɪˈsjut dʒʌst ðæt ˈsɛkənd tʃɑɹdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就只申訴第二筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly! See, this is why I came in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli si ðɪs ɪz waɪ aɪ keɪm ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 就是啊！你看，這就是我跑一趟的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally. Not his spending, not your problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəli nɑt hɪz ˈspɛndɪŋ nɑt jɔɹ ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 就是說。不是他花的錢，就不該算你的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we do that today, right here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən wi du ðæt təˈdeɪ ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 今天就能辦嗎？就在這個櫃台？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll open a dispute form right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪl ˈoʊpən ə dɪˈsjut fɔɹm ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，我馬上開一張申訴表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I get my money back fast?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl aɪ ɡɛt maɪ ˈmʌni bæk fæst/
dialogue.zh: 我的錢會很快回來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll get a temporary credit in about ten days.
dialogue.phonetic: /jul ɡɛt ə ˈtɛmpəˌrɛri ˈkɹɛdɪt ɪn əˈbaʊt tɛn deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 大約十天內，帳戶會先收到一筆臨時入帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Temporary? What does that mean exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɛmpəˌrɛri wət ˈdʌz ðæt min ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 臨時？那到底是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bank returns the money while we investigate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæŋk ɹɪˈtɝnz ðə ˈmʌni waɪl wi ɪnˈvɛstəˌɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 調查期間，銀行會先把錢退給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's actually very kind of the bank.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts ˈæktʃuəli ˈvɛɹi kaɪnd əv ðə bæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 噢，銀行這樣還挺有人情味的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, don't tell them that, they'll get a big head.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ doʊnt tɛl ðɛm ðæt ðeɪl ɡɛt ə bɪɡ hɛd/
dialogue.zh: 哈，別這麼跟他們說，他們會得意到飛起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does the investigation usually take?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ði ɪnˌvɛstəˈɡeɪʃən ˈjuʒəwəli teɪk/
dialogue.zh: 那調查通常要拖多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up to sixty days, but most finish sooner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌp tə ˈsɪksti deɪz bʌt moʊst ˈfɪnɪʃ ˈsuːnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 最長六十天，不過多半會更早結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if the store says it was legit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ðə stɔɹ sɛz ɪt wəz ləˈdʒɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那如果商店說這筆帳是合法的呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They need proof — receipts with your name on them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ nid pɹuf ɹɪˈsits wɪð jɔɹ ˈneɪm ɑn ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 他們得拿出證據——寫著你名字的收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A name they definitely do not have, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈneɪm ðeɪ ˈdɛfənətli du nɑt hæv ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那他們手上絕對沒有我的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. Meanwhile, this card number is burned, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ˈminˌwaɪl ðɪs kɑɹd ˈnʌmbɚ ɪz bɝnd ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 就是啊。另外，這組卡號已經外洩了，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Burned? Do I need a whole new card?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɝnd du aɪ nid ə hoʊl nu kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 外洩？所以我得整張換新？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a new number, issued free, it's policy.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə nu ˈnʌmbɚ ˈɪʃud fɹi ɪts ˈpɑləsi/
dialogue.zh: 是的，新卡號、免費補發，這是規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine by me. It really deserves the trash.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn baɪ mi ɪt ˈɹɪli dɪˈzɝvz ðə tɹæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我沒意見。這張卡本來就該丟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, mine says 'delete me' in tiny letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ maɪn sɛz dɪˈlit mi ɪn ˈtaɪni ˈlɛɾɚz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我這張卡簡直印著「請刪掉我」。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, um, where do I sign this form?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʌm wɛɹ du aɪ saɪn ðɪs fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，呃，這張表我要在哪裡簽名？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bottom line, plus the date, and one initial.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑtəm laɪn plʌs ðə deɪt ænd wʌn ɪˈnɪʃəl/
dialogue.zh: 最下面那一欄，加上日期，再簽一個縮寫字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One initial? Just the R for Rosa?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɪˈnɪʃəl dʒʌst ði ɑɹ fɚ ˈɹoʊzə/
dialogue.zh: 一個縮寫？就是 Rosa 的 R 嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's all fraud forms need these days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɑl fɹɑd fɔɹmz nid ðiːz deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 現在的防詐表格只要這些就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy. Do I keep a copy of anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi du aɪ kip ə ˈkɑpi əv ˈɛnɪˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好簡單。我需要自己留什麼副本嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This receipt has your claim number, keep it safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɹɪˈsit hæz jɔɹ kleɪm ˈnʌmbɚ kip ɪt seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 這張收據上有你的申訴編號，好好收著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will they email me while it's being worked on?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðeɪ ˈimeɪl mi waɪl ɪts ˈbin wɜɹkt ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 處理期間，他們會用電子郵件通知我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every two weeks, plus a text if they need you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹi tu wiks plʌs ə tɛkst ɪf ðeɪ nid ju/
dialogue.zh: 每兩週一封，需要你的時候還會傳簡訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Should I unfreeze while the new card waits?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ʃʊd aɪ ʌnˈfɹiz waɪl ðə nu kɑɹd weɪts/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。新卡還沒到之前，我要不要先解凍？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, stay frozen till the new number arrives.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp steɪ ˈfɹoʊzən tɪl ðə nu ˈnʌmbɚ əˈɹaɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 別，保持凍結，等新卡號到手再說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And should I have a talk with my grandson?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ʃʊd aɪ hæv ə tɔk wɪð maɪ ˈɡrænˌsɑn/
dialogue.zh: 那，我是不是該跟孫子好好談一談？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, about card numbers? Absolutely, gently, of course.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ əˈbaʊt kɑɹd ˈnʌmbɚz ˈæbsəˌlutli ˈdʒɛntli ʌv kɔɹs/
dialogue.zh: 哈，關於卡號這件事？當然要談，不過要溫柔地談。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He's seven, so gently is all I own.
dialogue.phonetic: /hiz ˈsɛvən soʊ ˈdʒɛntli ɪz ɑl aɪ oʊn/
dialogue.zh: 他才七歲，所以我有的就只有溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That explains the game items. Kids are hackers now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz ðə ɡeɪm ˈaɪtəmz kɪdz ɑɹ ˈhækɚz naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 難怪有那些遊戲消費——現在的小孩都是駭客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've seen a lot of these, huh?
dialogue.phonetic: /juz sin ə lɑt əv ðiːz hʌ/
dialogue.zh: 這種案子你一定見很多了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesdays and Thursdays, always the game stores.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzdeɪz ænd ˈθɝzdeɪz ˈɔlweɪz ðə ɡeɪm stɔɹz/
dialogue.zh: 星期二、星期四特別多，永遠是遊戲商店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, thank you for untangling all of this.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl θæŋk ju fɚ ʌnˈtæŋɡəlɪŋ ɑl əv ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 好啦，謝謝你陪我把這團亂理清。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. Watch your texts, and give that kid a talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪˌtaɪm wɑtʃ jɔɹ tɛksts ænd ɡɪv ðæt kɪd ə tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。留意你的簡訊，也跟那孩子好好談一次。

script.youtube_title: 【不明扣款💳】「現在的小孩都是駭客」兩筆可疑交易申訴記🏦📱｜臨時入帳・六十天調查・換新卡號｜聽完就會用｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Disputing Unknown Charges
script.youtube_title_en: "Kids Are Hackers Now" — Reporting a Card Charge You Don't Recognize
script.youtube_description:
提款卡上突然冒出兩筆看不懂的扣款，該怎麼辦？這一集 60 句沉浸式英語聽力，帶你坐進美國銀行的防詐櫃台，把不明交易申訴的每一步聽清楚。

你會聽到：跟行員說明「這筆不是我刷的」；確認自己已先鎖卡的問句；其中一筆發現是孩子瞞著刷的、另一筆仍是謎團時，如何在現場查證；申訴表、臨時入帳、六十天調查期這些關鍵詞；還有換新卡號與維持凍結的實用說法。

整段對話都是 A2 初級單字與十個詞以內的短句，充滿真實語感：um、well、ooh、haha。聽完你就會用：I have a charge I don't recognize、Ring a bell?、temporary credit、Watch your texts。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著唸，把申訴句型唸成直覺。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成母語。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱並打開小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
Two strange charges just appeared on your debit card — now what? This 60-line immersive listening practice sits with you at a real US bank fraud desk and walks through the whole dispute.

You will hear: telling the agent you don't recognize a charge, confirming the card is frozen, checking with family about who really used the card, and the key words of disputes: dispute form, temporary credit, sixty-day investigation, new card number.

Everything stays in A2-level words, ten per line at most, full of real texture: um, well, ooh, haha. By the end you'll own lines like Ring a bell? and Watch your texts.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let bank English become instinct.

No memorizing needed — listen often and it sticks.

晚上打開銀行軟體，帳單上多了兩筆你從沒見過的扣款，先該打給誰？鎖了卡之後呢？如果其中一筆是孩子瞞著你刷的，另一筆又是誰動過你的卡號？
